name: p0-01-no-shellhost-kill
title: P0-01 stop terminating ShellHost for injection
description: Audit P0-01: watch_and_inject(restart_stale=true) and inject_early() terminate ShellHost.exe, so the Start menu and Quick Settings visibly break. Default to not restarting the shell; keep the restart as an explicit opt-in.
